book.name: Mark
book.title: Yesu Keriso Tuyeghana Ahiꞌahina Mark Vivireina i Girugirumiya

content: Yesu, Rava Maghamaghau Dumahi (4,000) i Ghamohi

Na au marana, yana rava maghamaghauhi hi amtuborume. Ma Yesu maitehi hi maꞌae, ma i hanahanapu ma hi rautanighanei po ahi yam i kwaha. Yamna aubaina Yesu a tauvotagho i ghorehi po hi neꞌi auwarina, ma i riwehi ipa,
“We ravahi maghamaghauhina yana a nuwadubuwehi babana maitehi maratom tonugha ta maꞌae, ma egha ahi yam.
Inapa a am hiraghehi a himirihi ahi au numa, yana apo tayaha ausiporina hina raumoyaghahu. Ma wate ghehauhi yana uwamei hi neꞌi.”
A tauvotagho hi paribeei hipa, “Egha aiya wehidana ita maꞌamaꞌae, aubaina apo mepa payawa tana vaini po we ravahi ta hewahi?”
Anima Yesu i raubayadehi ipa, “Ma payawa habiꞌagha auwarimi?” Ma hipa, “Payawa 7.”
Anima Yesu patarana ghaeghaenana i riwehi po au dowa hi tughura. Ma na payawahi i vainihi po Maimaituwa i amamari ma i vokabakabari, ma a tauvotagho i verehi po hi raughutei rava boruhi auwarihi.
Wate auwarihi yana iyana muhomuhohi, po i viꞌamamara iyana aubaina ma a tauvotagho i riwehi po boruna auwarihi hi raughutehi.
Rava atapuhi hi amꞌam yana hi amhiyauwa duma. Anima yam am tereterenahi a tauvotagho poha 7 hi vihowai.
Na au marana yana rava maghauhi 4,000 nanaꞌarena. Ma aumurina yana Yesu i himirihi po hi vineyana ahi au numa.
Anima Yesu a tauvotagho maitehi hi geru au wam po hi damana au Dalmanutha.
Pharisees* Yesu hi Vibaghai da Matakiraha ita Dewai
Ma Pharisee ghehauhi hi neꞌi, po Yesu maiteni vipariꞌwayaꞌwaya hi vikareni. Hi ghohei po hita raudadani, aubaina hi vibaghai po matakiraha ita dewai, po hita inanai da moina tauna Maimaituwei i neꞌi.

Yesu aruwanei i yavutu aharena ma ipa, “Ahuu! Aiwa aubaina po we hapana o maꞌamaꞌae, oi baghaꞌu po matakiraha a dewai po ona inanai? Moinana a ririwemi da apo egha we hapana matakiraha awa a voghetei po ona inanai.”
Anima i voterehi ma au wam i geru, po i damaname hagahaga autupo ghehauna.
Yesu, a Tauvotagho* i Riwehi da Pharisees* ma Herod ahi Vihanahanapu hina Inana Vaimahiꞌeni
Ma Yesu a tauvotagho payawa nuwanuwahi i vuru, ma emosiꞌava hi vaini ma au wam hi geru.
Ma Yesu babani kajikajijirana i verehi ipa, “Ona inana vaimaiha, po Pharisees* ma Herod, ahi anihahana egha inai apoꞌapoenimi.”
Po tauhiꞌava hi taratarapiri hipa, “Egha payawa tata vaini, yamna aubaina anihahana e dedei.”
Ma Yesu ahi nota i hanapuwei po i raubayadehi ipa, “Aiwa oi nuwaboyei opa egha payawa ota vaini? Yohora oi nuwanaina? Nuwanuwami i pupu ma egha ita raughadari!
Waimatami ma egha ota inana tuhagha. Waitanighami ma egha ota rautanighana vaimaiha.
O nota tuhaghai bo eꞌegha, payawa 5 a vokahakahaiya rava maghauhi 5,000 auwarihi. Yana poha habiꞌagha, hi amteretereiya o vihowai?” Ma hi paribeei hipa, “12.”
“Ma wate payawa 7 a vokahakahaiya rava 4,000 aubaihi, yana hi amteretereiya poha habiꞌagha o vihowai?” Ma hi paribeei hipa, “7.”
Ma i riwehi ipa, “Aiwa atapuna yana o inanai pahi ma o nonori ma yohora po oi nuwanaina?”
Yesu, Matakeke i Viyawahani
Anima hi neꞌi Betsaida au meyagaina ma nahidana rava turahi matakeke hi neiyaꞌi Yesu auwarina, ma hi vibaghai po ita vodadani ma ita ahi.
Po Yesu matakeke i raunimani, ma ahi ruwagha meyagai hi hopu aharei. Anima au matana i hova ma nimana au matana i terei ma i raubayadei ipa, “Aiwa e inaꞌinanai?”
Ma orotona i tahepai ma ipa, “Rava a inanahi me eyagi ma he naenae.”
Anima Yesu nimana au matana i teremeei, ma matana i wanaghadari po ginauri atapuhi, i inana vaimahiꞌenihi.
Ma Yesu ipa, “Egha ma naenaeme au meyagaina, ma dumaruwei ma nae am au numa.”
Peter i Riwa da Yesu Keriso yana Maimaituwa a Vinevine Waiyawahanana*
Anima Yesu a tauvotagho maitehi hi veraunae Siseria Philippi, meyagaihi augheregherena. Maranai tauhi au tayaha yana a tauvotagho i raubayadehi ipa, “Rava he ririwa da taꞌu aiyaꞌi?”
Ma hi paribeei hipa, “Rava ghehauhi he ririwa da tam John Taubabataito,* ma ghehauhi he ririwa da tam Elijah ma ghehauhi he ririwa da tam peroveta ghehauna i vomahirime.”
Anima i raubayadehi ipa, “Ma taumi, me o ririwanei opa taꞌu aiyaꞌi?” Ma Peter ipa, “Tam yana Keriso, Maimaituwa a Vinevine Waiyawahanana.”*
Anima i vighaꞌehi po egha aiya hina ririwei da tauna Keriso, Maimaituwa a Vinevine Waiyawahanana.
Yesu, a Tauvotagho* i Riwehi da apo hina Vihiragheni ma ina Vomahirime

Anima Yesu i vikare po a tauvotagho i hanahanapuhi da apo aiwa auwarina ina tupuwa. Ipa, “Taꞌu, Rava Natuna, viuva ghaeghaena apo a viꞌaroni, mai Judea* ahi babada, gudutaupuyoweina* ghaeghaehi, ma raugagayo tauvihanahanapuweina apo hina geduꞌaiyeꞌu. Aꞌu ghaviya apo hina vihiragheniꞌu po maratom tonugha aumurina ma apo hiragheei a vomahirime.”
Weꞌi yana au habuhabuna Yesu i babaniyei, aubaina Peter i taravaini po auririva ma i vighaꞌei ipa, “Egha we nanaꞌarena am viuva ma am hiraghe mai babaniyei.”

Ma Yesu i ruhaghavirei po a tauvotagho i inanahi, ma Peter i eni, ipa, “Taumodurere* ma neꞌahareꞌu! Aiwa ei babaniyei yana egha Maimaituwa a rauhoghara ma dobu ravahi ahi vinuwanuwatuhuwei tam ei babani.”
Yesu Votaghona Anona
Yesu, a tauvotagho ma rava atapuhi i ghorehi po hi neꞌi augheregherena ma i riwehi ipa, “Aiya ravana votaghoꞌu ina ghohei yana ina boviyanamei, ma a korosi inaꞌavarai ma ina votaghoꞌu.
Rava aiya a yawahana ina nuwanei yana apo ina vineboꞌai, ma rava aiya a yawahana ina vineboꞌai tuyeghaꞌu ahiꞌahina ma votaghoꞌu aubaina, yana apo yawahana maꞌemaꞌe vavahaghana ina vaini.
Inapa rava ginauri atapuna au dobu ina vaini, ma egha yawahana maꞌemaꞌe vavahaghana ina vaini, yana we ginaurihi egha ana ahi aiwa tauna auwarina.
Inapa rava a yawahana maꞌemaꞌe vavahaghana ina vineboꞌai, yana apo egha aiwaꞌiyei ina vimaiha ma ina vainameei.

Rava we au dobuna he maꞌamaꞌae, yana aꞌu dewa hi geduꞌaiyei ma he dewadewaboꞌa. Ma inapa rava aiya i geduꞌaiyeꞌu ma i rovo po riwaꞌu we ravahi aunaohi egha ita vituyetuyeghei yana, Taꞌu Rava Natuna, apo a geduꞌaiyei. We apo ina tupuwa maranai aꞌu nememeꞌi amaꞌu a viguyauwei ma a aneya* vivireihi maitehi.”

footnotes.text: Mai Judea* ahi vinuwa notanota yana anihahana ampariruvaruvana ginauri apoꞌapoena e dabadabarara rava aupouhi me anihahana payawa auhinenina e dabadabarara. Yesu wehidana ei babaniyei yana Pharisees* ma Herod, Yesu egha hitai tumaghanei egha ina vaivainimi.
We ampariruvaruvana anona yana Yesu a tauvotagho, apo viuva ma vihinimaya hina viꞌaroni babana hi votaghoi. Egha ita ririwa da a tauvotagho hina hiraghe au korosi me tauna.
